partial_progress.details: Phases 1-4 remain landed and committed from prior dispatches (through cd421ee8). This dispatch re-derived the Phase 5 freeze mechanism from first principles, confirmed the prior dispatch's Investigation note is correct, and landed six new sorry-free, axiom-clean, purely additive declarations across three files (commit 4ffd1821): isRuleShape and intApplyRuleFull_notApplicable_iff in Rules.lean (a bare, nw/b-independent shape characterization of intApplyRuleFull's .notApplicable result); IFrozenBelow and intStepBranchPrioFirstPass_none_frozen in Expansion.lean (the checkpoint precondition and its derivation from intStepBranchPrioFirstPass returning none, i.e. exactly the moment intStepBranchPrio falls through to world-creation); and in Scheme.lean, IWorldHist_isAccessible_lt (a new label-order corollary of the already-landed IWorldHist/IWorldHistCounter invariants -- raw-edge accessibility only flows from smaller to larger labels, needing no new invariant threading) plus the freeze single-step conclusion family (IResultLabelsGe, IResultLabelsEq, IResultLabelsEq_imp_Ge, intApplyRuleFull_labels_eq_of_not_worldCreating, IFrozenBelow_intStepBranchPrio_ge) proving that one intStepBranchPrio step, given IFrozenBelow w0 e b and w0 <= nw, can only write new content at labels >= w0. This is mechanism 3(a) from the Investigation note, proved in full. Mechanism 3(b) (persistence-fixpoint preservation) is sketched but not yet formalized, and the multi-step composition into intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat's induction (needed for the actual IReuseContain_mono replacement Phase 6 wants) remains open -- both are recorded precisely in the plan's new Progress note. Full lake build green at 3325 jobs (unchanged job count), lake test green at 9397 jobs, TableauConformance's 20 rows unchanged, checkInitImports/lake lint/lint-style/shake/mk_all all clean on touched files. Stopped at this green boundary per explicit delegation-context instruction rather than rushing the remaining, substantially larger composition work.
